## Description
Please include a summary of the change and what issues are fixed. Briefly explain your approach.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification Checklist
Please verify that you have completed the following before submitting this PR:
- [ ] I have read the `INTERN_VERIFICATION_GUIDE.md`.
- [ ] I have run the local server and verified endpoints do not 404 or 500.
- [ ] I have run `pytest -q` locally and all 90+ tests pass.
- [ ] My commits are GPG-signed.
- [ ] I have not committed any sensitive keys or `.env` files.
